name: twin_last_band
caption: F6 last-band twin Δ per family and pooled, both embedding spaces. divergent is the F6 verdict.
alt_text: F6 last-band twin Δ per family and pooled, both embedding spaces. divergent is the F6 verdict.
limitations: n=2 last-band pairs per family. A last-band CI that includes 0 is no detected divergence, not occupancy of one lock. Waterloo bge-m3 point Δ stayed ~0.05 from band 0 (then divergent) to band 12 (CI grew to include 0 and a domain-sized gap). Reactor never excluded 0, including at band 0. Extra replicates would be required to claim sameness. ADR-0019: published twin CI columns used set(chosen) and are not bootstrap intervals. Point Δ is the observed mean. Occupancy embeddings were absent from the 2026-09-01 snapshot, so CIs were not re-derived. n=2; no detected divergence is not semantic collapse.
